2026_01_MIA_LV.headline: Miami’s healthy roster meets a Raiders offense missing Brock Bowers
2026_01_MIA_LV.paragraph1: Miami expects its full roster to be available, giving the Dolphins flexibility in the first game of the Jeff Hafley era, while Las Vegas has already ruled out Brock Bowers. That absence changes how the Raiders can threaten the middle of the field and increases the importance of Ashton Jeanty, Michael Mayer and protection around Kirk Cousins. Miami’s defense can crowd shorter windows if it controls the run; the Raiders need Crosby’s pressure and disciplined coverage to keep the Dolphins from turning favorable field position into quick points.
2026_01_MIA_LV.model_rationale: Miami carries the cleaner availability picture, while Las Vegas must replace Bowers’ middle-field influence and lean on defense to keep the game within a manageable script.
